topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes the class and introduces the scope and historical context of studying the complement system.

topics.label: Overview and fundamentals of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics provide a foundational overview of the complement system's architecture and the pivotal activation of C3.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the three recognition pathways and convergence threshold that trigger complement activation on target surfaces.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the primary effector mechanisms through which activated complement eradicates pathogens.

topics.label: Regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the host regulatory proteins and mechanisms that prevent self-directed complement attack.

topics.label: Clinical complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the clinical manifestations and disease risks resulting from deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic analyzes the evolutionary strategies pathogens use to circumvent complement-mediated immune destruction.

topics.label: Closing remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture and previews the next lecture on the adaptive immune system.
